slides.texte_overlay:
clear signs your brain
works better than average

you're happy alone with your thoughts

you can spend hours with your own mind without feeling bored. a brain that keeps itself company usually has a lot of interesting things going on inside it.

you update your opinions

when someone shows you good evidence, you change your mind without a fight. being able to say i was wrong is one of the clearest signs of a strong mind.

you always want new ideas

your brain keeps asking for something new to learn, and you feed it a little every day. a mind that is always hungry for ideas tends to keep getting sharper.
slides.texte_sophia:
you always want new ideas

my brain always wants something new. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and even that small dose keeps my mind sharp and happy.

slides.texte_overlay:
you ask how things work

you can't hear about something new without wondering how it actually works. constant questions are the quiet habit behind almost every brilliant mind in history.

you link unrelated things

you connect ideas that seem to have nothing in common: a song and a memory, a habit and a mood. spotting hidden connections is a powerful kind of intelligence.
